text:
Matt: Soft freeze in ~90m for v2.3.7-hot1. Only minimal diffs allowed — fixes only, no migrations or packaging changes. Ping here if you need an exception.

Priya: Noted. Branch flow? staging -> release/2.3.x?

Matt: Yep. Cut to release/2.3.x. Cherry-picks go to that branch; DevOps will trigger backport job.

Jordan: I have a tiny kv-cache timing guard fix (PR #4893). Single-line change. Need a reviewer before I cherry-pick.

Emily: Adding review now. Will run tests.

Priya: @Jordan please include a one-line changelog blurb in the PR: "fix: kv cache timeout guard — avoids NPE under high load". Keep it terse.

Jordan: Will update PR description. Cherry-pick command I'll use: `git checkout release/2.3.x && git cherry-pick -x 3a7f9c2`

release-bot: CI queued for branch release/2.3.x — 1 job pending, 2 required checks.

Matt: @Emily once CI passes can you merge and tag? I'll coordinate the deploy window and smoke.

Emily: On it. Smoke plan: deploy to canary (1 pod) -> health checks + small load test -> promote. ETA ~30m after merge.

DevOps: Reminder: official cutoff is 18:00 UTC. Any merges after that will be deferred to the next cycle. Also: avoid migrations or config toggles in hotfix.

Jordan: CI passed on my PR, tests green. Changelog line added. Ready for cherry-pick.

Emily: Merged PR #4893 into release/2.3.x and tagged v2.3.7-hot1. Release job started.

release-bot: Release artifact built: redwood-inference-2.3.7-hot1.tar.gz — checksum abc123def — deploy queued to canary.

Matt: Canary looks good after 10m smoke. No errors/leaks in logs. Proceeding to roll to 20% traffic.

Priya: Observability shows no regressions at 20%. :thumbsup:

DevOps: Rolling to 100% in ~10m. If rollback needed, react here and ping @oncall.

Jordan: Thanks everyone — nice and small.

Matt: Great job. I'll post a short post-release note and close this thread once fully rolled.
